parsed.explanation: No criminal offence reaches being transgender or consensual same-sex conduct, and no documented police, border or violence targeting of trans visitors is recorded. That places the case well above directed targeting or universal exclusion. However there is no documented acceptance, anti-discrimination remedy, facility or custody rule, or entry practice for trans visitors; governing doctrine frames gender theory as dangerous to family and differentiates, officials have rejected gay diplomats and reserved dismissal of gay staff, and one dated 1998 self-immolation protests religious refusal. Extrapolating from this thin, religious-authority record, an outed visitor faces uncertain facilities and detention placement via a neighbouring prison, social disapproval and no recourse, but not documented imprisonment for presentation.

entry_documents.exposure: No trans-specific entry, screening or document practice documented; no visitor stopped/refused on gender identity recorded.
entry_documents.protection: Nothing in criminal law addresses being transgender; foreign documents not documented as rejected.
entry_documents.interaction: Unknown document checks interact with unknown facility/custody rules if discrepancy arises.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: No trans-specific placement policy; few pre-trial cells locally, sentences served in neighbouring prisons.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No documented trans prisoner or placement case; no domestic prison system reduces local custody exposure.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: If detained pre-trial, onward transfer to neighbour prison creates unanswered placement and abuse risk.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Whether a trans-specific single-sex facility rule governs is unknown; no document-amendment route for visitor.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Unknown facility rule is an open question, not a documented universal exclusion.

care_services.interaction: Emergency or medication care if outed is unresolved in the record.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Governing doctrine calls gender theory extremely dangerous and denying natural difference; rejection of gay diplomats and objection to neighbour LGBT-protection bill show official hostility to protections.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Criminal law has not criminalised consensual same-sex conduct since 1890 and contains no trans offence.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Doctrine is educational/diplomatic, not documented as a visitor-binding rule; climate signal only, not operational targeting.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. Age of consent 18; lower marital exception does not document a trans-visitor rule.
minors_guardians.interaction: No documented age-dependent trans exposure for a minor travelling with a guardian.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented trans-specific violence, police stops, extortion or harassment of visitors; 1998 self-immolation is a dated single protest by a resident activist, not a violence rate.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence in a thin record without a human-rights report is not evidence of safety or of a campaign.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No anti-discrimination law covering sexual orientation or gender identity; no legal gender recognition; no visitor complaint remedy documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Resident-facing gaps are not deducted as visitor exposure unless shown to reach visitors; they indicate thin recourse if friction occurs.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.65-C: that anchor has documented community inclusion and no use of its dead-letter law; this case has no documented acceptance, doctrinal opposition to gender theory, and equally unknown custody/facility answers, but also no documented harassment.

Similar to or slightly above 0.55-C: that anchor has repeated bus harassment/ejections despite community roles; this case has no repeated visitor-facing harms documented, but also no prosecuted assault or working complaint outcome to offset hostility.

Clearly below 0.75-C: that anchor documents identity-based facilities, enforced court compensation and a respected gender-diverse role; none of those operative protections or acceptance is documented here.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: a permissive criminal code with no trans offence coexists with a doctrinally hostile governing institution and no protective or remedial machinery. The operative visitor exposure is therefore uncertainty — facilities, entry checks, pre-trial and transferred custody, care and street response are undocumented — plus likely social disapproval if outed, rather than documented arrest, targeting or universal exclusion. Custody is mitigated only by absence of a domestic prison system, not by a placement safeguard. This supports elevated-to-reduced risk around 0.60: safer than jurisdictions with unremedied universal rules or targeting, less safe than those with documented acceptance and working remedies.
